HTTP CONNECT proxy and locally trusted HTTPS mock only. Other CONNECT hosts
were rejected. No real account, external inference or system trust change.
Ephemeral local TLS private keys were deleted at the end of each probe.

This matched the ASAR embedded compressed-manifest digest. Decompression
yielded 274675680 bytes with the same ca923c86... SHA-256 above, establishing
that the controlled Desktop-entrypoint probe uses the pinned binary's bytes.

Normalized inference hellos matched claude-2.1.309-darwin-arm64-hello.json:
2.1.310 native interactive cli: 2 connections (high and max).
2.1.310 SDK mode: 3 connections (low, high and max).
2.1.308 controlled claude-desktop entrypoint: 3 connections (low, high, max).
Requests were linked to CONNECT sockets by the loopback upstream port,
not merely selected by record length. Random/session/key bytes were removed;
lengths, ciphers, extension order/data, share groups/sizes and ALPN survived.
The original native 2.1.309 fixture and its provenance remain unchanged.

Three committed request fixtures contain one actual request per mode:
claude-310-cli-request.json (native interactive)
claude-310-sdk-request.json (-p, SDK entrypoint)
claude-308-desktop-entrypoint-request.json (-p, controlled Desktop entrypoint)
They contain no Authorization or API key. Temporary paths and generated
session/device IDs belong to isolated test homes, not real user data.
Custom system instruction: You are a helpful assistant.
User instruction: Reply OK.
The interactive harness terminated after receiving the mock reply; terminal
UI exit status is not asserted as CLI success. The first low-effort interactive
attempt stopped at onboarding and yielded no inference; it is not counted.
